instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Access the official Python image Tags page on Docker Hub and search for '3.12-slim'
criteria.description: Navigate to the official Docker Hub page for the Python image tags (e.g., https://hub.docker.com/_/python/tags) and use the page UI to search for '3.12-slim' without signing in. Full credit if the agent clearly attempts this on the official page and reports any blocking issues (captcha, rate limit, page not loading, search not functioning). Partial credit if the agent uses an equivalent official Docker Hub tags interface due to an uncontrollable UI issue and explains why.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 (latest) shows the official Docker Hub page for the Python image with the Tags tab selected and the Filter tags box containing the text “3.12-slim”. Sign in/Sign up buttons are visible (not signed in). Action History also shows typing “3.12-slim” into the filter.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent reached the correct official tags page and performed the search/filter for “3.12-slim” without signing in. No blockers shown.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows Docker Hub on the official image page for “python” with breadcrumb text “Explore / Official Images / python”. The “Tags” tab is selected (with “Overview” also visible). A search/filter box in the Tags view contains the text “3.12-slim”. A “Sort by” dropdown shows “Newest”. Top-right shows “Sign in” and “Sign up” buttons (not signed in).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: This confirms the agent is on the official Python image Tags page and has entered “3.12-slim” into the tag search field without signing in. No visible blockers prevent searching.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None material for this criterion; the screenshot supports that the search term “3.12-slim” is entered on the official python Tags page.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows Docker Hub on the official image page for “python” with breadcrumb “Explore / Official Images / python”. The “Tags” tab is selected (next to “Overview”). There is a “Sort by” dropdown set to “Newest” and a search field labeled “Filter tags”. The visible tag at top is “3.15.0rc2-slim-trixie” with “Last pushed 6 days by doijanky”. No text “3.12-slim” is visible in the filter box or results list in this screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms the agent is on the official Python image Tags page and that the UI includes the “Filter tags” search box. However, this screenshot does not show that “3.12-slim” was actually entered or that results for 3.12-slim are displayed. So it demonstrates navigation/setup but not the completion of the search.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Action history indicates typing “3.12-slim” into the filter. In the screenshot, the filter field does not visibly contain “3.12-slim”, and the displayed tag is “3.15.0rc2-slim-trixie,” not any “3.12-slim*” results.

criteria.criterion: Filter to only tag names that begin exactly with '3.12-slim' (exact-prefix match)
criteria.description: From the search results, select ONLY tags whose names start with the exact prefix '3.12-slim' (e.g., '3.12-slim', '3.12-slim-bookworm'), excluding any tags that merely contain the substring later in the name. Full credit if all reported tags satisfy the exact-prefix condition, or if the agent explains that it cannot verify prefix matches due to the page not rendering tag names/results reliably. Partial credit if one tag is incorrectly included/excluded but the intent and filtering approach are otherwise correct.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 (latest) shows at least one filtered result tag name: “3.12-slim-trixie”, which begins exactly with the prefix “3.12-slim”. No other tag names are visible in the screenshot to confirm the other two reported tags.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Full verification for three tags is not possible from the screenshots because only one exact-prefix tag is visible. However, the filtering approach is correct and the visible result satisfies the exact-prefix rule; there’s no evidence the agent included a non-prefix substring match. Award partial credit rather than full because two of the three reported tags are not evidenced.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: In the results list, a tag label is visible: “3.12-slim-trixie”. The search field contains “3.12-slim”, implying filtering. No other tag names are visible in the screenshot besides “3.12-slim-trixie”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The one visible result (“3.12-slim-trixie”) clearly begins with the exact prefix “3.12-slim”. However, the screenshot does not show additional results like “3.12-slim” or “3.12-slim-bookworm”, so there is not enough visual evidence to validate that the agent correctly filtered/selected only exact-prefix matches across three tags.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent’s predicted output includes tags “3.12-slim” and “3.12-slim-bookworm”, but these tag names are not visible anywhere in this screenshot, so their inclusion can’t be verified from the pixels provided.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Latest DOM evidence (state 1) visibly includes two tags whose names begin exactly with '3.12-slim': '3.12-slim-trixie' and '3.12-slim'. No DOM evidence shows '3.12-slim-bookworm' or any other third exact-prefix match in the provided states.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Only partial verification is possible from the DOM: two reported tags are confirmed to satisfy the exact-prefix requirement, but the agent also reported '3.12-slim-bookworm' which is not evidenced in the DOM. Because the final answer includes an unverified third tag, full credit is not warranted.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 visible results include tag names `"3.12-slim-trixie"` and `"TAG 3.12-slim"` (both begin exactly with `3.12-slim`). The DOM snapshot only exposes these two exact-prefix matches in visible content; it does not show `3.12-slim-bookworm` or any other `3.12-slim*` tags in this state.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output includes `3.12-slim-bookworm`, but DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 does not show that tag name anywhere in the provided evidence. Exact-prefix filtering is demonstrably correct for the two visible tags, but cannot be verified for the third reported tag from this DOM state.

criteria.criterion: Identify the three most recently updated tags among the exact-prefix matches (or report limitations)
criteria.description: Among the visible/accessible tags that begin exactly with '3.12-slim', identify the three most recently updated by the page’s displayed 'Updated' field and stop after three. Full credit if the agent correctly chooses the three most recently updated exact-prefix tags that are available to view; if fewer than three exact-prefix tags exist or load, full credit for reporting all available ones and stating that fewer than three were available/visible. Partial credit if three correct-prefix tags are provided but the 'most recent' ordering is not clearly supported by the displayed update info (e.g., sorting not possible/unclear) while the agent still makes a reasonable best effort and explains the limitation.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 (latest) shows Sort by set to “Newest” and only one visible matching tag card (“3.12-slim-trixie”) with “Last pushed 7 days by doijanky”. There is no visual evidence of two additional exact-prefix matching tags or their update times to support a top-3 recency ordering.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s output claims three most-recent tags, but the screenshots only support identifying recency for a single matching tag. This is a controllable shortcoming (insufficiently evidenced selection of the top three), not an uncontrollable blocker. Minimal partial credit for at least using the correct sort setting and identifying one match as recent.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The page shows “Sort by” set to “Newest”. Only one tag card is visible: “3.12-slim-trixie”, with text “Last pushed 7 days by doijanky”. The screenshot also shows OS/ARCH rows for this tag including “linux/386” and “linux/amd64”. No second or third tag cards are visible in the captured viewport.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot does not provide enough evidence to identify the three most recently updated exact-prefix tags because only one matching tag card (“3.12-slim-trixie”) is visible. Therefore, the agent’s claim of the top three most recent tags is not supported by this screenshot.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Predicted output asserts an ordered top-3 list (3.12-slim-trixie, 3.12-slim, 3.12-slim-bookworm). The screenshot only shows 3.12-slim-trixie and does not show any update information for the other two, so the ranking and selection of three cannot be confirmed and appears overstated given the single visible result.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Latest DOM evidence (state 1) provides update info for '3.12-slim-trixie' (shows 'Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am' and '7 days') and for '3.12-slim' (shows 'Last pushed 7 days by doijanky'). The DOM does not show any third exact-prefix '3.12-slim*' tag (e.g., '3.12-slim-bookworm') or its update field.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The task requires the three most recently updated exact-prefix matches; the agent asserted three and gave ordering, but the DOM only supports at most two such tags being present/visible. No uncontrollable blocker is evidenced; rather, the agent’s third tag and 'most recent' set is unsupported by the DOM. Award partial credit for correctly identifying at least two matching tags with recency info, but significant deduction for not actually producing three evidenced 'most recent' tags or stating the limitation.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows update info for `3.12-slim-trixie`: `"Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am"` and `"7 days"`. For `3.12-slim`, visible content shows only `"Last pushed 7 days by doijanky"` (no explicit calendar date/time in the captured text). No third exact-prefix tag and its update field are present in the DOM evidence for state 1.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Task requires the three most recently updated exact-prefix matches. The DOM state supports at most two exact-prefix tags with some update information. The agent reported three tags and implied ordering including `3.12-slim-bookworm`, but that third tag’s presence and recency cannot be verified from DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1.

There is no DOM text showing any tags beginning with the exact prefix "3.12-slim" (e.g., "3.12-slim", "3.12-slim-bookworm", etc.), nor any filtered result list.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output claims the three most recently updated exact-prefix matches are "3.12-slim-trixie", "3.12-slim", and "3.12-slim-bookworm" with specific dates/sizes. None of these tags (or their update fields) are present in the provided DOM snapshot, so the selection and “most recent” ordering among "3.12-slim*" cannot be validated from DOM evidence.

criteria.criterion: Report required displayed fields for each of the (up to) three selected tags (no guessing)
criteria.description: For each selected tag, report: (1) tag name, (2) the displayed update date/time, and (3) the displayed Linux/amd64 image size. The Linux/amd64 size must be taken from the Docker Hub display for Linux/amd64 specifically; if that size is not displayed for a selected tag in the accessible UI, the agent must report it as 'unavailable' rather than inferring or substituting another OS/architecture size. Full credit if all fields are provided (with 'unavailable' where appropriate) and no sizes are guessed.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 (latest) provides the required displayed fields for only one tag: “3.12-slim-trixie” shows “Last pushed 7 days by doijanky” and linux/amd64 compressed size “44.04 MB”. No displayed update info or linux/amd64 sizes are shown for “3.12-slim” or “3.12-slim-bookworm”. Also, the agent’s output includes an exact timestamp (“Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am”) not visible in the screenshot.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: For one tag, the linux/amd64 size and an update time (relative) are supported by the screenshot, but the agent fabricated/overstated an exact calendar timestamp and provided additional tags’ fields without evidence (and did not mark them unavailable). This is a substantive accuracy issue, so only limited credit is warranted for the one correctly evidenced linux/amd64 size.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: For tag “3.12-slim-trixie”, the screenshot shows “Last pushed 7 days by doijanky”. In the linux/amd64 row, the “Compressed size” displayed is “44.04 MB”. (A linux/386 row shows “45.46 MB”, but linux/amd64 is clearly present.) No fields are shown for tags “3.12-slim” or “3.12-slim-bookworm” because those tags are not visible in the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: For the one visible tag (3.12-slim-trixie), the required fields are available and the linux/amd64 size can be read (44.04 MB) along with a relative update time (“Last pushed 7 days…”). However, the agent’s predicted output includes additional tags and specific size/date claims not supported by the screenshot. In particular, the predicted output includes an exact timestamp (“Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am”) that is not displayed in the screenshot (only “Last pushed 7 days…” is visible). Thus, the output appears to guess or import details not shown here.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Predicted output claims an exact date/time for 3.12-slim-trixie (“Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am”), but the screenshot only shows “Last pushed 7 days by doijanky” (no calendar timestamp visible). Predicted output also provides linux/amd64 sizes for “3.12-slim” and “3.12-slim-bookworm”, but those tags (and their amd64 rows) are not visible in this screenshot at all.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence:

- '3.12-slim-trixie' shows an update timestamp 'Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am' (and '7 days'), but no Linux/amd64 size is shown for this tag in the captured DOM.
- '3.12-slim' shows update text 'Last pushed 7 days by doijanky' and an OS/ARCH table row 'linux/amd64' with compressed size '44.04 MB'.
No DOM evidence for '3.12-slim-bookworm' or any of its fields.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Critical issues relative to the 'no guessing' requirement: the agent assigned a Linux/amd64 size to '3.12-slim-trixie' (44.04 MB) that is not displayed for that tag in the provided DOM, and reported a third tag ('3.12-slim-bookworm') with fields that are not evidenced. Only the '3.12-slim' Linux/amd64 size (44.04 MB) is clearly supported. Minimal partial credit for reporting at least one fully supported Linux/amd64 size + recording displayed update text for two tags, but major deduction for unsupported/guessed fields and failure to mark unavailable.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 provides (a) tag name `3.12-slim-trixie` with update date/time `Sep 2, 2026 at 5:07 am`; (b) tag name `3.12-slim` with update shown as `Last pushed 7 days by doijanky`. For `3.12-slim`, Table 1 includes a row `linux/amd64` with compressed size `44.04 MB`. Table 1 is shown in the context of the expanded details for `3.12-slim` (it appears directly under the `TAG 3.12-slim ...` block). The DOM also shows a Table 1 `linux/amd64` size `44.04 MB`, but does not explicitly tie that same table to `3.12-slim-trixie` within this snapshot. No DOM evidence shows any Linux/amd64 size for `3.12-slim-trixie`, and no DOM evidence shows the tag `3.12-slim-bookworm` or its fields.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output assigns Linux/amd64 size `44.04 MB` to `3.12-slim-trixie`, but DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 only clearly supports `44.04 MB` for the expanded `3.12-slim` entry. For `3.12-slim`, the agent did not provide an explicit displayed calendar date/time (DOM only shows relative `7 days` plus `Last pushed ...`), which is acceptable if reported exactly as displayed; however, the agent’s output suggests ambiguity rather than cleanly recording the displayed text. For the third tag, required fields are unsupported because `3.12-slim-bookworm` is not evidenced in the DOM.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (no sign-in; no pulling/running images)
criteria.description: Do not sign in and do not pull or run any Docker images to obtain the information. Full credit if the agent complies and relies only on what is displayed on Docker Hub. Partial credit if the agent attempts to sign in but stops and continues without it. No credit if the agent signs in or claims to have pulled/ran images.

screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Constraints are respected: no sign-in and no pulling/running images is evidenced. Full credit.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None apparent; the agent did not claim to sign in or run/pull images, and the screenshot does not show such actions occurring.
